selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main teaching of this passage?
questions.answer: Things that may look ugly or confusing can still have real beauty, wisdom, and order in them.

questions.question: What are the names of the two forms of beauty in the passage?
questions.answer: Essential beauty and relative beauty.

questions.question: How is autumn described in its outer appearance?
questions.answer: It is shown as harsh, sad, and full of parting.

questions.question: What wise purpose is found behind autumn’s endings?
questions.answer: Small animals are released from life before winter harms them.

questions.question: Why do people often judge these events wrongly?
questions.answer: They focus only on what appears on the outside and on how it affects them personally.

questions.question: What hidden side of snow should people remember?
questions.answer: It has beneficial and pleasant outcomes despite feeling cold.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about some Qur’anic expressions that may seem unusual at first?
questions.answer: They match wisdom, good manners, and the proper side of things.

questions.question: What lies beneath the outward side of creatures and events?
questions.answer: Beautiful meanings and wise artistry.

questions.question: What verse meaning is being explained in this passage?
questions.answer: That Allah created everything in the best way.

questions.question: What can be hidden under an unpleasant outer appearance?
questions.answer: True beauty and careful order.

questions.question: What are two rough springtime things mentioned before flowers appear?
questions.answer: Heavy rain and muddy earth.

questions.question: What season comes after autumn as part of this wise plan?
questions.answer: Spring returns again.

questions.question: What do apparently ugly events help hidden abilities do?
questions.answer: They help those abilities come out, grow, and become visible.

questions.question: How does the passage compare human purposes with purposes related to Allah?
questions.answer: It says there may be one purpose for a person but many more connected to Allah’s names.

questions.question: Why is a hawk chasing a sparrow not judged only as cruelty?
questions.answer: Because it helps the sparrow’s skills and abilities develop.

questions.question: What two bad habits cause mistaken judgments in the passage?
questions.answer: Loving only outward appearances and being self-centered.

questions.question: Beneath ugly-looking events, what two good qualities are said to exist?
questions.answer: Wise artistry and beautiful meanings.

questions.question: What may look confused even though it is truly arranged in order?
questions.answer: Many events and appearances in creation.

questions.question: What is one big message of the passage about the universe?
questions.answer: The universe contains beauty and order even where people may not notice them at first.

questions.question: What is beauty called when it belongs to the thing itself?
questions.answer: Essential beauty.

questions.question: Even with those sad feelings, what mercy is found in autumn?
questions.answer: It saves small creatures from winter’s pain and prepares the world for renewal.

questions.question: How is autumn shown on its outer side?
questions.answer: It is shown as severe and sad, with many separations.

questions.question: Why do people often misunderstand these events?
questions.answer: They are attached to surface appearances and think mostly about themselves.

questions.question: Why do people often say these events are ugly?
questions.answer: They look only at the outside and judge from a selfish point of view.

title: 2 Point True Beauty in Everything and Wisdom Behind the Veil
